notes: 1.0.0: egress -- one WireGuard exit per container: the cores forward a policy's traffic to it, and it leaves only through the tunnel, masqueraded (the owner, 2026-11-26: policy-based routing to VPN exits). wireguard-tools configures the kernel's wireguard link (the module is loaded by the host's kmod policy, never from the container), iproute2 addresses it and routes forwarded traffic into it with a blackhole behind (no fall-through), nftables is the exit's firewall and NAT, and hibr runs the tunnel's bring-up and its health loop. No bash, no coreutils. Rolling throughout.
